start_date.summary: IE says the Noida agitation started Nov 25, before this December unit.

activity_in_month.summary: About 5,000 farmers marched Dec 2 and sat/negotiated at the Delhi-Noida border; the march is inside Nov25–Dec5 agitation.

end_date.summary: IE reports the agitation ended Dec 5 after assurances.

episode_continuity.summary: IE describes the Dec 2 march as after an eight-day protest and the Dec5 end as same agitation; no second December-start event.

description: Continuation of the Greater Noida land-acquisition protest owned by November onset; includes the Dec2 march and reported Dec5 end.
open_questions: Does a future local report document any activity after Dec5?
Were the Dec2 march and prior sit-in one episode? Keep pending reviewer judgment.

prior_activity.summary: Reuters says farmers had camped at Shambhu on Punjab–Haryana border since Feb 2024 after police halted their march.

activity_in_month.summary: On Dec6 about 100 farmers attempted to resume a foot march toward Delhi and were met with tear gas and pepper spray.

demands.summary: Higher crop prices, legal guarantees of state support, debt waiver and promised income increase directed at government.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Reuters directly reports about 100 simultaneous marchers.

state_response.summary: Reuters reports tear gas and pepper spray by police; no immediate injuries reported.

episode_continuity.summary: Long-running camp and paused March-to-Delhi movement began Feb; December activity recorded as continuation absent proof of a completed prior episode/new onset.

description: Continued long-running farmers’ camp/Delhi Chalo action first reported in February 2024; Dec6 foot march is not assigned a new onset in this Q4 dossier.
open_questions: Does a discrete Dec6 march after a period of camp constitute a separate event despite continuity of the campaign?
Which additional state-response outcomes occurred beyond tear gas/pepper spray?
